name: boreal_elemental_opponent_spell_pays_two_more
notes: Pde50e67e9e G4. Printed: 'Spells your opponents cast that target this creature cost {2} more to cast.' Seat 1 controls Boreal Elemental (3/4). Seat 0 casts Disfigure ({B}) at it: the total is {2}{B}, and a pool of exactly {B}+{2} is spent to the last mana (CR 601.2f). The Elemental is 1/2 until end of turn.
